notes.title: Wishlist our next game!
notes.content:
Thank you 
First, a big thanks to everyone who has played, and are continuing to play Lemonade Apocalypse. I am grateful that so many enjoyed the game. I have decided to make it into a bigger and longer experience with lots of new gameplay and possibilities while maintaining the core experience of Lemonade Apocalypse. So, here is Lemonade Apocalypse: The Great Filter!

Wishlist here
Lemonade Apocalypse: The Great Filter on Steam

What is "The Great Filter"?
It's an homage to the Fermi Paradox. The Great Filter is a resolution to the Fermi Paradox, which states that since there is no observable extraterrestrial intelligent life, there might be something that always stops a civilization in its way—the Great Filter. In our case, each of the 27 endings of this game is a potential "filter," like global overheating.

Where we are in development
I've teamed up with an illustrator and composer/sound designer to build the expression from the ground up. We have designed a concept and implemented new art, music, and sound design in the first stage. I have spent the better part of my free time the past months developing the gameplay, and I've conducted 2 user tests. Both have given me ideas on how to improve the game further. Right now I am implementing new ideas to the first stage and factory stage. And after that I will prepare the final stage for testing aswell.

Hope to see you destroy the world again. And again. And again.
Since the game has 27 different endings and gameplay combinations, Prestiging will be exciting to explore. Gain bonuses for each playthrough while checking out the different paths you can take.

Release date depends on quite a few factors, so I don't want to promise a release date just yet. But stick around for updates!

Meanwhile here's the Discord.

notes.title: Credits updated with an announcement of the next game
notes.content:
Next game..!
The credits now feature a button to sign up for a newsletter about upcoming games.

Humble beginnings
Lemonade Apocalypse was made during a Gamejam. Its length, limited mechanics and so forth is a result of that.
Well! Now there's a new version in the works. I hope you look forward to making impactful choices, new mechanics, a meaningful prestige system and many different endings!

Links

Please subscribe to the newsletter if this interests you! I promise I won't spam. You can unsubscribe at any point.

May humanity prevail and not succumb to forces of greed,
Geir

notes.title: Lemonande Apocalypse: Steam Edition releases April 5th!
notes.content:
Friday, April 5th!
Is when the game is released! I chose a Friday because I believe Lemonade Apocalypse is a great way to unwind after a long week. I don't know about you, but my attention span can be kind of short on a Friday evening so I often find myself trying to find a game I can easily get into and potentially finish in one sitting.

Lo and behold
Lemonade Apocalypse can be finished in an hour, and on the way to getting some free achievements you will see the satirical story of greed unfold.

Why free?
No in-app purchases? No data mining? What's the catch?? Well, this is the first game I made. And it has a special place in my heart because of that. My desire was to share it on Steam, so after revisiting the code and design a few years later I decided to publish it, and now it's here!

Thanks to the rest of the team
I wrote, designed and programmed this game as a part of a game jam arranged by the Game on Mid Sweden, Skill Up! program. With Patty Toledo paving the way for us new game developers, myself and the rest of the team learned a lot about game development and this game was our first result.

Post release
I will keep my eye out for bug reports and other quality of life improvements and work on that. Game dev is a continued learning experience, so I am open to all feedback after release - both positive and constructive.
